The First Super Game Agent — Open-Source Full-Stack AI Game Studio 

 
 
 

 
 
 
 
 

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 

 Quick Start · Agents · Playable Templates · Why OpenGame · Publish & Monetize · Setup & MCP · Community 

 

 English · 简体中文 · 日本語

 

 Introducing OpenGame

OpenGame is the first open-source Super Game Agent — turning DeepSeek (DSH) , Claude Code , Codex , or any of your local coding agents into an AI Unreal Engine / Unity and full-stack game studio. Go from a single idea to AAA-grade 3D worlds or monetization-ready viral mini-games in one end-to-end pipeline.

- 🚀 Build AAA-Grade 3D Games with Your Agent. Drive full-stack 3D gameplay, art, music, and voice straight from DeepSeek (DSH) , Claude , Codex , or Gemini — from one prompt to playable 3D action, racing, and open-world games.
- 🎮 One-Click Remix & Re-style Any Game. Start from 25 built-in playable templates (3D, voxel, anime, pixel & 9:16 hits) with full editable source — keep proven mechanics while swapping characters, worlds, and art styles in minutes.
- 💰 Build Games That Earn: Create → Verify → Monetize. Automated logic checks, balance simulation, headless playtesting, covers, and gameplay trailers — ship live web links, export single-file 9:16 Playable Ads , and connect publishing paths for WeChat Mini Games , TikTok , and Douyin .
- 🔓 Full-Stack Open Source (BYOA + BYOK). Code, art, video, music, voice, SFX, and Three.js 3D are all open source — plug in your favorite local agent and own API keys, or connect OpenDesign Go (Black Friday lowest-ever discount, with free access to DeepSeek V4.1 Flash , Seedream , and more).

 

 ⚡ Quick Start

 1. Give one prompt to your local Agent

Paste this instruction into DeepSeek TUI / Harness , Claude Code , Codex , WorkBuddy , Cursor , Gemini CLI , or any of the 22 supported local agents:

 

 2. Install the Main OpenGame Skill with Skills CLI

Install the main opengame entry Skill (which guides local setup and routes into openmotion-game + 18 game craft, 3C, animation, playable-ad, and QA reference handbooks) with the Skills CLI:

 

 Installing the Skill copies the OpenGame entry instructions into your agent (you can also install --skill openmotion-game directly). Complete the local Studio & MCP setup below so your agent can call the 12 openmotion game tools and open Game Studio.

 3. Run OpenGame Studio locally from source

Requires Git , Git LFS , npm , and Node.js 22.18+ (CI pins Node.js 26.11.1). Browse the catalog immediately after startup. Playing or remixing a template downloads its assets on first use. Tidebreaker works offline.

 

 

 Works with 22 local agents (BYOA) · Choose your agent

 

 

 🕹️ Playable Game Templates & Showcase

OpenGame ships with 25 ready-to-play games right inside templates/games/ — complete with playable HTML5 / Three.js source, artwork, controls, and localization. Play them locally in Game Studio, Remix any title with one click, or Re-style it into your own IP, theme, or brand.

 3D, Voxel & Action Games (16:9)

 
 
 
 
 Tidebreaker · 3D · Racing · Three.js 
Race a speedboat through a storm-lashed archipelago, jump wave crests, dodge reefs, and beat the tide across eight checkpoints. 
 Inspect source & DESIGN.md → 
 
 
 
 Starlight Bastion · Voxel · Shooter · Upgrades 
Defend a luminous crystal against five escalating waves of voxel invaders, choosing roguelite upgrades between waves. 
 Inspect source & DESIGN.md → 
 
 
 
 
 
 Skyline Courier · 3D · Platformer · Cyberpunk 
Run, leap, and wall-kick across rain-soaked cyberpunk skyscrapers to deliver three final parcels in 90 seconds. 
 Inspect source & DESIGN.md → 
 
 
 
 Neon Drift · 3D · Racing · Cyberpunk 
Weave through rain-slick neon highway traffic, chain near-misses to recharge boost, and chase a new distance record. 
 Inspect source → 
 
 
 
 
 
 Comet Guard · Shooter · Space 
Pilot an orbital interceptor in a painted starfield, shatter molten comets, and defend the station through escalating waves. 
 Inspect source → 
 
 
 
 Harbor Skirmish · 3D FPS · Grapple & Slide 
A stylized 3D first-person shooter on a curved island with double-jump, slide, dash, and grappling-hook mobility. 
 Inspect source → 
 
 
 

 Stylized, Narrative & Atmospheric Games (16:9)

 
 
 
 
 Glyph Garden · Anime · Puzzle · Fantasy 
Trade moonlit petals and trigger cascading combo blooms to reach 2,200 points in 24 moves. 
 Inspect source → 
 
 
 
 Lantern Hop · Pixel · Platformer · Fantasy 
Guide a scarf-wearing pixel fox across layered moonlit rooftops, double-jumping gaps and collecting glowing paper lanterns. 
 Inspect source → 
 
 
 
 
 
 Lighthouse Log · Anime · Visual novel · Survival 
Keep a coastal lighthouse burning through seven stormy nights, rationing fuel and making impossible radio choices. 
 Inspect source → 
 
 
 
 Last Light · Horror · Atmospheric 
Search an abandoned school for three keys before your torch dies while keeping the pursuing shade pinned in your beam. 
 Inspect source → 
 
 
 
 
 
 Night Train Letters · Visual novel · Branching Narrative 
Three unsent letters on a rain-soaked night train to the sea — an intimate branching narrative built in pure HTML. 
 Inspect source → 
 
 
 
 Stack the Moon · Casual · One-Tap Arcade 
Build a moonlit observatory above the clouds one timed stone at a time; chain perfect landings to widen your tower. 
 Inspect source → 
 
 
 

 Viral Portrait Mini-Games & Playable Ads (9:16)

Built for mobile thumbs, instant first-frame engagement, short high-retention loops, and mini-game / playable-ad monetization :

install.html:
1. Give one prompt to your local Agent

Paste this instruction into DeepSeek TUI / Harness, Claude Code, Codex, WorkBuddy, Cursor, Gemini CLI, or any of the 22 supported local agents:

Follow https://github.com/nexu-io/opengame/blob/main/docs/opengame-setup.md to connect OpenGame to this agent. For a new install, use a shallow clone (--depth 1) and skip LFS downloads. Open the Game Studio template gallery so I can choose a game. Fetch that game's assets when I play or remix it.
If you find a reproducible OpenGame bug, you're welcome to open a PR against nexu-io/opengame with the fix, steps to reproduce, and how you verified it.
2. Install the Main OpenGame Skill with Skills CLI

Install the main opengame entry Skill (which guides local setup and routes into openmotion-game + 18 game craft, 3C, animation, playable-ad, and QA reference handbooks) with the Skills CLI:

npx skills add https://github.com/nexu-io/opengame/tree/skills --skill opengame

Installing the Skill copies the OpenGame entry instructions into your agent (you can also install --skill openmotion-game directly). Complete the local Studio & MCP setup below so your agent can call the 12 openmotion_game_* tools and open Game Studio.

3. Run OpenGame Studio locally from source

Requires Git, Git LFS, npm, and Node.js 22.18+ (CI pins Node.js 26.11.1). Browse the catalog immediately after startup. Playing or remixing a template downloads its assets on first use. Tidebreaker works offline.

git -c filter.lfs.process= -c filter.lfs.smudge= -c filter.lfs.required=false clone --depth 1 --single-branch --branch main https://github.com/nexu-io/opengame.git
cd opengame
git lfs install --local --skip-smudge
npm ci
npm run build:studio
npm start

Works with 22 local agents (BYOA) · Choose your agent
